# Project Context

This is a collage generator application.

## Goals
- responsive image collage system
- automatic layout optimization
- multi-canvas support when overflow occurs
- futuristic dark UI with gradients
- images displayed as cards

## Constraints
- JavaScript / TypeScript
- no backend initially
- performance-sensitive (canvas + images)
- maintainable for solo/small team

## Priorities
1. Layout quality
2. Performance
3. UX consistency
4. Maintainability
5. Visual design
